scope: Installed TypeScript S01 text/vector-bearing/hybrid subset only; not the full Phase 1 protocol
candidate_artifact_note: Package metadata still says 0.8.26 before release version bump; source SHA and archive bytes identify the post-Slice-132 candidate. Product source and Cargo.lock are unchanged between b2ac8081e and this freeze.
timing_boundary: Installed TypeScript async method invocation through resolved materialized SearchResult; corpus setup, model loading and semantic verification excluded
pair_summary_rule: Report all five per-pair deltas, their median and full observed range for every size/query/statistic; no significance claim or regression threshold from five pairs
resource_rule: Report GNU Time child user/system CPU, peak RSS, filesystem block I/O, major faults and swap per block; do not attribute whole-worker resources to an individual query
cold_rule: Report each session-first observation as a diagnostic; do not call it cold OS/model cache or calculate a cold percentile
invalid_block_rule: Preserve every attempt. Require clean source checkout, archive/installed byte match, exact protocol and runner hashes, semantic checks on every result, 1000 valid warm observations per cell, stable host/CPU/storage/governor and Node version, no competing build/profiler, at least 1 GiB free and zero measured-child swap events. Host-only swap drift is a warning with sensitivity analysis.
candidate_verdict_rule: Diagnostic latency comparison only. Report regressions, improvements and uncertainty separately from accepted release gates; do not infer correctness from version agreement.
phase1_limit: This S01 TypeScript subset cannot close the complete installed-SDK functional exercise, S02, E01-E12, Pareto, robustness or logic/exception matrices.
